states.label: Pop highest-priority position
states.description: Pop only after the active search card has checked its entire predicate list and pushed every matching board position.

states.label: Inspect board position
states.description: Read the oracle predicates and choose the next DFA state. Board positions remain positions; proof and backtracking are DFA transitions.

rules.label: this line proves the current candidate
a required opponent reply refutes the candidate
our candidate failed; try the next candidate
our turn: scan one ordered predicate list
opponent reply set is forcing and enumerable
the previous capture creates a recapture reply class
search the certified objective-relevant reply classes
opponent replies are not classifiable under this policy

states.label: Our move — one ordered predicate card
states.description: One card only. Scan the entire ordered predicate list from top to bottom, retain every legal move that matches at least one predicate, and push the complete priority-ordered set before any position is popped.

states.label: Forcing opponent replies
states.description: The opponent move set is already constrained: at most two legal replies, or a bounded set of legal answers to check. Enumerate every reply, ordering the most materially damaging first.

states.label: Recapture reply class
states.description: The preceding move was a material capture. Retain every certified recapture or other reply that can refute or repair the objective; omit only replies certified not to recover it.

states.label: Opponent reply classes
states.description: The opponent has too many legal moves to enumerate. Retain every oracle-certified objective refutation or repair class and fail loudly if the set cannot be certified.

states.label: Pop after proof
states.description: A chosen move worked. Pop remaining required opponent replies; lower-priority moves from the same choice will be skipped by the next inspect state.

states.label: Continue required replies / skip alternatives
states.description: Required opponent replies must still be discharged. Lower-priority alternatives to an already successful move are skipped by DFA transition, not represented as fake positions.

rules.label: skip a lower-priority alternative because this choice already worked

states.label: Pop next candidate
states.description: The current move failed. Pop the next lower-priority move from the same ordered candidate set.

states.label: Try candidate or propagate failure
states.description: A sibling candidate is tried normally. Encountering a required reply means no candidate remained to answer that reply, so failure propagates outward.

rules.label: no candidate answered the required reply; propagate failure

states.label: Pop out of failed reply set
states.description: One required opponent reply refuted the current move. Discard its remaining sibling replies until the next parent-level candidate is reached.

states.label: Discard replies / try parent candidate
states.description: Skip remaining replies belonging to the failed move. The next candidate belongs to the enclosing choice and is inspected normally.

rules.label: discard another reply belonging to the failed candidate

states.label: Solved
states.description: The highest-priority successful choice discharged every required opponent reply. Lower-priority alternatives were skipped by DFA transitions.

states.label: Failed loudly
states.description: Every candidate failed, or a required line was refuted, unexplorable, missing, or over budget.
